subject: Proposal: 12-month renewal for Docs & UI localization
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@linguafy.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Linguafy Sales <sales@linguafy.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal: Docs & UI localization (Mar 2026 - Mar 2027)

Hi Laura,

Following our Q4 review, attached is our formal 12-month renewal proposal for Redwood's docs and UI localization program. Summary highlights: 
- Scope: 10 product locales for UI + continuous docs localization across 4 repos (docs.redwood.com, sdk docs, tutorials, admin guides)
- Volume estimate: ~120k source words/mo (avg) + spikes for minor releases
- SLA: 48-hour standard turnaround for high-priority fixes, 5 business days for standard content
- Pricing: $82k/mo subscription (includes translation memory, LQA, and 1 on-call linguist)
- One-time set-up fee: $6k (model training + CAT tooling sync)

Attachments: Linguafy_Renewal_Quote_2026.pdf (quote + SOW)

We can offer a brand discount of 8% for an annual commitment if signed by 31 Mar. Also noted your ask about data residency — we have a US-only storage option and can scope an addendum for tighter retention. 

Happy to jump on a quick call this week to walk through the line items.

Best,
Elena Gomez
Account Lead, Linguafy
elena.gomez@linguafy.com
+1 415-555-0128
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:46:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal: Docs & UI localization (Mar 2026 - Mar 2027)

Forwarding the vendor quote — see attached PDF. Key points: 82k/mo + 6k setup; 8% if we sign by 31 Mar.

Questions for Marcus / Priyom:
- Marcus: can you confirm if the $82k/mo fits within the localization budget for product + docs this FY? Also, is the LQA scope (1 on-call linguist) reasonable for our release cadence?
- Priyom: procurement & legal — what additional compliance language / PO terms do we need to request (data residency addendum, SOC2 attestation, IP assignment)?

If this looks reasonable I can ask for a draft PO and push for the 8% discount. Want to close this before the next release window.

Thanks — Laura

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:08:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal: Docs & UI localization (Mar 2026 - Mar 2027)

Laura — thanks for flagging. I reviewed the quote and ran the numbers against our localization cost model. Quick notes:

- Budget: $82k/mo (~$984k/yr) is higher than last year's run rate (~$760k) but includes expanded UI locales and continuous docs. We have ~20% headroom if we reallocate from contractor spend.
- TM/Reuse: Need clarity on match rates and how much new word count is expected after we feed latest TM. If Linguafy can guarantee >=65% leveraged matches for docs (post-TM sync) the effective monthly volume should drop.
- LQA coverage: 1 on-call linguist seems low for simultaneous multiple streams (docs + UI). Recommend asking for optional 0.5 FTE for LQA coverage during peak releases.
- Data handling: require SOC2 Type II report (redacted ok) + confirmation that source content is stored only in the US (no EU backups).

Attached internal eval: Redwood_Linguafy_Eval_Sheet.xlsx (line-item checks + suggested redlines).

Action items I propose:
1) Ask for line-item pricing (UI vs docs vs TM) so we can stage billing.
2) Negotiate 10% discount for annual prepay or commit to quarterly with 8% as fallback.
3) Ask for a 30-day SLA credit for missed turnarounds on critical fixes.

Happy to take point on negotiation if Priyom ok with terms.

- Marcus
Product Ops
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:53:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal: Docs & UI localization (Mar 2026 - Mar 2027)

Thanks both — quick procurement/legal notes: 

- PO & payment: procurement requires a PO to match the invoice. For annual prepay we'll need CFO approval; otherwise quarterly invoices + Net 30 is fine.
- Compliance: ask Linguafy for SOC2 Type II report, data residency addendum (US-only), and an IP clause that states Redwood retains final ownership of localized content. Also request a standard DPA with retention <= 90 days after termination for non-production assets.
- Terms to push: 10% discount for annual prepay OR 9% for annual with 60-day signature window. Counter-offer on SLA credit (Marcus' suggestion).

If you want me to run the PO and contract I can. I recommend locking price before we ship the next minor release (target 2026-04-01).

Priyom
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@linguafy.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: Docs & UI localization (Mar 2026 - Mar 2027)

Elena — thanks for the proposal. We reviewed internally and have a few requests before we can sign: 

- Please provide line-item pricing (UI vs docs vs TM) and confirm expected leverage/match rates after TM sync.
- Can you adjust the annual pricing to 10% off if we commit to an annual prepay by 31 Mar? Alternatively 9% if we need a 60-day signature window.
- Please attach SOC2 Type II (redacted is fine) and confirm US-only storage option + DPA with <=90 day retention for non-prod data.
- Add a 30-day SLA credit for missed critical turnarounds.

If you can send an updated quote and a draft DocuSign, Priyom will run the PO and Marcus will validate LQA coverage. We want to finalize before our April release.

Next steps / owners: Priyom (PO/contract), Marcus (scope & TM validation), Laura (sign-off).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Developer Docs & Localization
Redwood Inference
